title: ImUi Debug Draw Response Surface v1
problem: Make the public IMUI debug-draw helper usable as an app-queryable item surface by returning source-level draw-list summaries and an opt-in pressable response without adding Dear ImGui renderer callbacks, raw buffers, or backend-owned hit testing.

repro.summary: Build and run the cookbook debug-draw example, then validate the promoted diagnostics smoke that now waits for response metadata.
commands: FRET_DIAG=1 cargo run -p fretboard-dev -- diag suite cookbook-imui-debug-draw-basics --launch -- cargo run -p fret-cookbook --features cookbook-imui,cookbook-diag --example imui_debug_draw_basics

gates.name: diag script validate
gates.command: cargo run -p fretboard-dev -- diag script validate tools/diag-scripts/cookbook/imui-debug-draw-basics/cookbook-imui-debug-draw-basics-smoke.json --json

gates.name: diag suite run
gates.command: FRET_DIAG=1 cargo run -p fretboard-dev -- diag suite cookbook-imui-debug-draw-basics --launch -- cargo run -p fret-cookbook --features cookbook-imui,cookbook-diag --example imui_debug_draw_basics

continue_policy.notes: This response-surface slice is closed. Future debug-draw work should start as narrower follow-ons for per-geometry hit testing, renderer attribution, or pixel/layout diagnostics.
